title: "NMR ensemble with RMSF"
description: "The 2K39 ensemble aligned on its core and coloured by RMSF."
video: videos/synchronized_plots.mp4

{{< video videos/synchronized_plots.mp4 >}}

The ensemble is aligned in memory, the per-residue RMSF is computed with MDAnalysis and
     stored as an attribute, and the cartoon reads it through `Color Attribute Map` while all
     116 models play.

     The contact map, sequence track, distance trace and legend that ProteinMotion draws beside
     the structure are plot annotations Molecular Nodes does not have yet.

After ProteinMotion's [`synchronized_plots.py`](https://github.com/pdpppd/proteinmotion/blob/main/examples/synchronized_plots.py).

## Script

Run it with `uv run python docs/examples/timeline/scripts/synchronized_plots.py out_dir`; set
`MN_EXAMPLES_QUICK=1` for a small, fast check. The script is included from the file:

```{.python filename="scripts/synchronized_plots.py"}
{{< include scripts/synchronized_plots.py >}}
```
